Overview

About the H200 NVL

NVIDIA H200 NVL is the air-cooled, dual-slot PCIe version of the Hopper H200 GPU. It pairs 141 GB of HBM3e with 4.8 TB/s of bandwidth, giving up to 1.7x faster LLM inference and 1.3x faster HPC than H100 NVL.

Up to four GPUs can be linked with NVLink bridges at 900 GB/s, and a five-year NVIDIA AI Enterprise subscription is included, making it a strong fit for enterprise racks with standard air cooling.

141 GB HBM3e

Run larger models and datasets without sharding them across GPUs.

4.8 TB/s bandwidth

Feeds memory-bound LLM inference and HPC workloads.

NVLink bridges

2- or 4-way NVLink at 900 GB/s per GPU; up to 8 GPUs per server.

AI Enterprise included

Five-year NVIDIA AI Enterprise subscription with NIM microservices.

Air-cooled

Configurable up to 600 W within standard enterprise cooling.

Confidential computing

Protects sensitive data and models while they are processed.
